note: Authored French display overlay for recipes.json. NO runtime machine translation. recipes.json stays the canonical English dataset; this file only supplies fr display strings (name, description, cuisine, category, per-ingredient label + quantityText). It never affects recipe ids, ingredient keys, alternatives (anyOfKeys), structured amounts/units, ranking or fallbackRank. Validated against recipes.json by recipeLocalization.js: every recipe id and every ingredient key must be covered, with non-blank strings within the recipes.json length limits.
